tracks.title: Carrot Nose
tracks.subject: A girl builds a snowman in the park at lunchtime and ties her crush's lost red scarf on it, hoping he walks past and recognises it
tracks.caption: 1968-70 bubblegum pop. Fuzzy combo organ playing bouncy staccato eighth-note riffs, handclaps and tambourine on every backbeat, a round bouncy bass guitar walking in simple root-fifth patterns, straight-eighth drums with a crisp snare. Dry punchy AM-radio studio sound, light spring reverb, slightly compressed mix. Bright unison lead female vocal with a double-tracked octave, simple chanted sing-along hooks. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 120 BPM, G major. Bouncy, sugary and a little cheeky. No strings, no sax, no synths, no autotune, no modern pop gloss, no rapping, no EDM drums.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - fuzzy organ riff, handclaps, tambourine]

[Verse 1]
Built him a snowman by the park gate
Rolled the middle ball till it weighed a ton
Found a red scarf on the bench last week
His name sewn inside it, in green

[Pre-Chorus]
I tied it round the snowman's neck
Now I'm waiting at the lamppost
Wait, wait, wait

[Chorus]
Carrot nose, carrot nose
Tell him it was me
Ooh, I built you in the snow
So he'd stop and say hello

[Verse 2]
Here he comes with his lunch in a bag
Stops and stares at the lump of white
Pulls the scarf and laughs out loud
Says whoever did this got it right

[Chorus]
Carrot nose, carrot nose
Now he's turned around
Ooh, he's got the scarf in hand
Looking round to see who's there

[Outro - organ riff, handclaps, sing-along tag]
Thank you, carrot nose
Thank you, carrot nose

tracks.title: Ticket Number Forty-One
tracks.subject: A man pawns his guitar to buy his wife a ring, and the pawnbroker lets him play it every Sunday before the shop opens
tracks.caption: Russian-bard-style acoustic guitar poetry in English, kitchen-table storytelling. Single nylon-string guitar with steady arpeggio verses and strummed Am-E7 choruses, occasional bass-string thumb runs, sparse low male harmony on the last line of each chorus. Dry close-miked room, no reverb tail, soft finger noise. Male baritone, plain warm voice, unhurried storytelling phrasing. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 92 BPM, A minor. Wry and tender. No drums, no synths, no strings, no autotune, no rapping, no pop polish.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - nylon guitar arpeggio]

[Verse 1]
I carried it in wrapped in a coat
Past the bakery, past the bank
The man behind the glass said
Forty pounds, and here's your stub

[Chorus]
Forty-one, forty-one
Hang it on the hook
I will come on Sunday
Before the shutters rise

[Verse 2]
The pawnbroker is a quiet man
He wiped the strings with his sleeve
Said it still holds the pitch
Better than my ledgers do

[Verse 3]
Now the ring is on her finger
Plain and thin, it fits her well
She asks me where I go on Sundays
I say to see an old friend

[Chorus]
Forty-one, forty-one
He lets me hold the neck
She came along last Sunday
And she asked me for a waltz

[Outro - nylon guitar, slow strum]
Forty-one, forty-one
Sunday, at nine

tracks.title: Shoe the Horse
tracks.subject: A Midrand farrier can only fit a cart-horse's new shoes while a slow house track plays, because the old horse stamps in time and stands still
tracks.caption: South African kwaito-pop, slowed 1990s township house groove. Heavy kick and clap pattern, deep rounded sub bass, shaker running straight eighths, warm Rhodes-style piano stabs, a bright whistle melody on the hook. Warm wide mix with light hiss. Male lead voice, relaxed and bright, female group answering each line in call and response. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 108 BPM, F minor. Playful, loose, easy to dance to. No rapping, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no guitars, no EDM drops, no orchestra.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - kick, shaker, Rhodes stabs]

[Verse 1]
Sunday at the stable, Midrand side
Old grey horse, he will not stand
I bring the hammer, I bring the nails
He wants the beat or he wants no part

[Pre-Chorus]
Press play, press play
Hold his foot, hold his foot

[Chorus]
Shoe the horse, shoe the horse
Hammer on the one
Ooh, he nods and he stays
Four new shoes by the end of the day

[Verse 2]
Left front foot on my leather apron
He stamps along with the bass
I file the hoof, I fit the iron

[Pre-Chorus]
Turn it up, turn it up

[Chorus]
Shoe the horse, shoe the horse
Hammer on the one
Ooh, the old horse stamps in time
Cart is waiting by the gate

[Outro - whistle, shaker, Rhodes]
Shoe the horse
One more foot

tracks.title: Gold Leaf Mistake
tracks.subject: A shop-front sign-writer gilds the name of a new bakery in gold leaf, spells it wrong, and the owner keeps it because queues form to point at it
tracks.caption: Acid jazz, 1990s London club session sound. Rhodes electric piano playing syncopated minor-seventh chords, wah-wah rhythm guitar chopping on the offbeats, trumpet and tenor sax horn stabs on the chorus, round slap-leaning electric bass, tight live drums with ghost-note snare, congas. Dry punchy drums, wide Rhodes, tight horn section. Male lead voice, smooth and clear, female backing pair answering. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 108 BPM, D minor. Cheeky and groovy. No Hammond organ, no synth leads, no autotune, no rapping, no four-on-the-floor EDM kick.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes, wah guitar, conga]

[Verse 1]
Brush in my hand at seven in the morning
Gold leaf lifting off the book
Baker wants his name across the window
Bread and Butter, but I wrote Breed

[Pre-Chorus]
Steady hand, steady hand
One long breath, then it's dry

[Chorus]
Breed and butter, breed and butter
Look what I've gone and done
Now the queue goes round the corner
Everybody's pointing up

[Verse 2]
I came back with my turpentine
The baker said leave it, it's perfect
He sold out before the noon

[Chorus]
Breed and butter, breed and butter
Look what I've gone and done
He's paid me twice the fee
Gold is gold and wrong is right

[Bridge - horns, drums break]
One letter, one letter
Now it's on a postcard

[Chorus]
Breed and butter, breed and butter
Look what I've gone and done
Better than the proper one
Everybody's pointing up

[Outro - wah guitar, Rhodes vamp]
Breed and butter
Breed and butter

tracks.title: The Friday Key
tracks.subject: A woman who has wound the town-hall clock every Friday for thirty years is handed a quartz replacement and asks to wind it one last time with the new mayor
tracks.caption: Finnish tango iskelma, minor-key schmaltz in the Suomi-tango tradition. Accordion carrying the melody with long legato phrases and sharp staccato dotted rhythm, nylon-string guitar strumming, upright bass walking on the beat, soft brushed snare, small string pad on the chorus. Soft hall reverb, close accordion. Male baritone, rounded warm voice, slightly formal delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 84 BPM, A minor. Wistful, dignified, a little proud. No loud drum kit, no synths, no autotune, no rapping, no electric guitar, no pop beat.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - accordion, nylon guitar]

[Verse 1]
Every Friday at a quarter past four
I climb the stairs of the old town hall
Ninety steps and a rusted door
The iron key is warm in my hand

[Verse 2]
Thirty years I've turned the crank
Now they bring a box with a battery
They say it never loses a minute

[Chorus]
Let me wind it once more
Before you take the key
Oh, the town will keep its time
But who will keep it kind

[Verse 3]
The new mayor stands beside me
Coat too thin for the cold of the tower
I show him how to lift the lever
He breathes out when it starts

[Bridge - accordion alone, then guitar]
Four chimes, then five
Hold the weight, let it fall

[Chorus]
Let me wind it once more
You may keep the key
Oh, the town will keep its time
And the battery can wait

[Outro - accordion, slow strings]
Ninety steps down
The clock goes on

tracks.title: Cincin Longgar
tracks.subject: a young goldsmith in a Pasar Atom Surabaya stall who resizes the same engagement ring three times because the customer's girlfriend's finger swells in the heat, until the man asks him to make it one size loose so it can stay on through every season
tracks.caption: Balkan turbo-folk, driving 9/8 dance groove with a 2+2+2+3 stomp. Clarinet playing fast ornamented melody lines with quarter-tone slides, piano accordion answering in short staccato phrases, synth strings holding sustained chords, darbuka and live kick on the stomp, rounded bass guitar. Glossy club-folk mix, tight drums, bright accordion. Male vocal, mid-high register, bold and cheeky, sung clearly in Indonesian. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 120 BPM, A minor. Playful, stomping mood. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drops, no rap, no electric guitar solo, no reggaeton rhythm.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - clarinet and accordion]

[Verse 1]
Tiga kali kamu datang ke tokoku
Cincin yang sama, ukuran yang lain
Katamu jarinya kembung kena panas
Waktu hujan cincinnya lepas sendiri

[Pre-Chorus]
Kukikir, kuukur, kusepuh lagi
Kamu tawar sambil senyum sendiri

[Chorus]
Cincin longgar, cincin sempit, mana yang pas
Emas dua puluh empat, hatimu belum jelas
Cincin longgar, cincin sempit, ayo tentukan
Aku tukang emas, bukan tukang ramalan

[Verse 2]
Bulan Agustus jarinya gemuk sedikit
Bulan Desember katanya kurus lagi
Kamu bawa kotak merah buat kali keempat
Aku sudah hafal angka di buku catatan

[Pre-Chorus]
Kukikir, kuukur, kusepuh lagi
Kamu diam, lalu bilang pelan

[Chorus]
Cincin longgar, cincin longgar, kasih satu ukuran lebih
Biar tetap di jarinya waktu panas dan hujan
Cincin longgar, cincin longgar, jangan terlalu pas
Cinta bukan kotak sempit, katamu, aku setuju

[Outro - accordion and clarinet]

tracks.title: Angsa Es
tracks.subject: a hotel ice sculptor in Bandung who carves a swan for the breakfast buffet each dawn, watches it drip away by noon, and finally carves a swan small enough to melt in the palm of the pastry girl he loves
tracks.caption: Colombian vallenato, paseo rhythm with a lilting two-step pulse. Diatonic accordion playing a flowing melody with trills and bass-button responses, caja vallenata hand drum on the beat, guacharaca scraper keeping the continuous rasp, acoustic guitar strumming steady chords, plucked acoustic bass. Dry live room, natural reverb, close accordion. Male vocal, mid register, warm and earnest, sung clearly in Indonesian. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 112 BPM, G major. Warm, courting mood. No electronic beats, no autotune, no pop synths, no rap, no reggaeton dembow, no distorted guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - accordion, caja and guacharaca]

[Verse 1]
Jam empat pagi aku sudah di dapur hotel
Balok es sebesar lemari kupahat
Bulu angsa kuhaluskan sampai tembus lampu
Jam dua belas siang lehernya mulai menunduk

[Chorus]
Angsa es, angsa es, kau cepat sekali pergi
Tetes demi tetes jatuh ke baki perak
Angsa es, angsa es, ada yang lewat membawa kue
Dia tersenyum, aku yang meleleh duluan

[Verse 2]
Rina dari bagian kue lewat tiap pukul sembilan
Dia lap meja dekat angsaku yang basah
Katanya, Mas, bagus sekali, sayang cuma sehari
Kujawab pelan, yang sehari itu justru yang kupilih

[Chorus]
Angsa es, angsa es, kau cepat sekali pergi
Tetes demi tetes jatuh ke baki perak
Angsa es, angsa es, hari ini kupahat yang kecil
Cukup untuk satu telapak, kuletakkan di tangannya

[Verse 3]
Dia pegang erat sambil tertawa kedinginan
Air mengalir dari jari ke pergelangan
Besok kuukir lagi, kataku, tiap pagi
Dia bilang, kalau begitu, besok aku datang lebih pagi

[Outro - accordion and guacharaca]

tracks.title: Titik Kumpul
tracks.subject: a volunteer fire warden in a Glodok electronics mall in an orange vest and helmet who shoos three hundred stall owners out in the monthly drill, and at the assembly point finds the phone-case girl counting heads and saying one person is still missing: him
tracks.caption: UK 2-step garage, swung skippy 2-step beat with a shuffled snare. Deep rounded sub-bass playing syncopated bass line, Rhodes electric piano on warm minor-seventh chords, soft synth pad underneath, crisp finger-snaps and light shaker. Clean club mix, punchy shuffled snare, warm sub-bass. Female vocal, mid register, smooth and playful, melodic R&B singing with stacked backing harmonies, sung clearly in Indonesian. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 132 BPM, F minor. Flirty, bouncing mood. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap, no dubstep wobble, no four-on-the-floor house kick, no distorted guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes and shuffled 2-step drums]

[Verse 1]
Sabtu pagi bunyi sirene di lantai dua
Pria berompi oranye berdiri di tangga
Tiga ratus kios, semuanya pura-pura tuli
Ada yang masih menghitung uang di laci

[Pre-Chorus]
Ayo keluar, ayo keluar
Ini cuma latihan, tapi tetap jalan

[Chorus]
Di titik kumpul aku menghitung kepala
Satu, dua, tiga, kok kurang satu orang
Di titik kumpul semua sudah di luar
Yang belum keluar cuma kamu, Pak Petugas

[Verse 2]
Kamu periksa kios sampai ujung koridor
Kamu cek stopkontak dan tabung pemadam
Kamu lupa periksa jalan keluar buat dirimu
Aku pegang daftar nama, jariku mulai gelisah

[Pre-Chorus]
Kamu muncul dengan helm miring
Aku pura-pura marah, padahal senyum

[Chorus]
Di titik kumpul aku menghitung kepala
Satu, dua, tiga, sekarang sudah lengkap
Di titik kumpul bunyi sirene berhenti
Latihan lagi bulan depan, jangan terlambat

[Outro - Rhodes and sub-bass fade]

Kamu cek stopkontak dan tabung pemadam
Kamu lupa periksa jalan keluar buat dirimu
Aku pegang daftar nama, jariku mulai gelisah
[Pre-Chorus]
Kamu muncul dengan helm miring
Aku pura-pura marah, padahal senyum
[Chorus]
Di titik kumpul aku menghitung kepala
Satu, dua, tiga, sekarang sudah lengkap
Di titik kumpul bunyi sirene berhenti
Latihan lagi bulan depan, jangan terlambat
[Outro - Rhodes and sub-bass fade]

tracks.title: Tabung Melon
tracks.subject: a 3-kilo gas cylinder deliveryman in a Bekasi rusun who carries one up four flights on his shoulder, paid in coins by every tenant and given tea by an old lady on the fourth floor, counting his steps like dance steps
tracks.caption: Sri Lankan baila, bouncing 6/8 party groove. Dholak playing the rolling baila pattern, mandolin strumming and picking bright rhythmic figures, trumpet and trombone playing short answering brass riffs, clean rhythm guitar on the offbeat, rounded electric bass, shaker. Bright live party mix, punchy brass, dry dholak. Male vocal, mid register, loud and cheerful, sung clearly in Indonesian. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 108 BPM, A major. Upbeat, cheeky mood. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap, no EDM drops, no distorted guitar, no reggaeton rhythm.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - dholak, mandolin and brass]

[Verse 1]
Tabung melon di bahu, kakiku mulai berhitung
Lantai satu, satu dua, lantai dua, tiga empat
Tangga rusun sempit, bau sambal di mana-mana
Tiap pintu terbuka, tangan menyodorkan receh

[Chorus]
Satu, dua, tiga, naik tangga sambil menari
Tabung melon, tabung melon, jangan jatuh ke kakiku

Seratusan campur limaratusan, kuhitung ngos-ngosan
Lantai empat nenek Ijah sudah siapkan teh manis
Katanya, Nak, duduk dulu, jangan buru-buru turun

[Chorus]
Satu, dua, tiga, naik tangga sambil menari
Tabung melon, tabung melon, tehnya masih panas
Satu, dua, tiga, turun lebih ringan
Tabung melon, tabung melon, kantongku bunyi gemerincing

[Outro - dholak, mandolin and brass]

tracks.title: Angka di Meteran
tracks.subject: a PLN electricity meter reader in a Malang lane who reads each household's life in its monthly numbers, and one month a long-silent house jumps overnight and he knocks to find the son who has come home
tracks.caption: Italian cantautore, intimate storytelling ballad in the manner of 1970s Genoa songwriters. Nylon-string acoustic guitar fingerpicking a steady arpeggio, upright piano adding sparse answering chords, string quartet entering on the chorus with long warm lines, soft brushed drums. Intimate studio, close room sound, soft strings. Male vocal, low-mid register, warm storyteller delivery, sung clearly in Indonesian. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 76 BPM, D major. Tender, unhurried mood. No electronic beats, no autotune, no pop synths, no rap, no distorted guitar, no big drum fills.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - nylon guitar and piano]

[Verse 1]
Tiap tanggal dua puluh aku jalan di gang ini
Senter kecil, buku saku, pensil di telinga
Rumah bujangan di ujung, angkanya tipis saja
Rumah pengantin baru, angkanya naik pelan

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku tidak pernah bertanya
Angka-angka itu bercerita sendiri

[Chorus]
Angka di meteran, kubaca seperti buku harian
Lampu menyala lebih lama, ada yang belum tidur
Angka di meteran, tak ada yang bisa bohong
Tiap rumah ada ceritanya, kutulis dengan listrik

[Verse 2]
Rumah Bu Wati di pojok, bertahun-tahun datar
Satu lampu dapur, kipas kecil, itu saja
Bulan ini angkanya melompat, semalam saja
Dua ratus sekian, kulihat dua kali

[Chorus]
Angka di meteran, hari ini aku mengetuk pintu
Seorang pria memasak, kopernya masih di lantai
Angka di meteran, Ibu tertawa di belakangnya
Kutulis dengan hati-hati, angka yang paling kusuka

[Outro - strings and nylon guitar]

tracks.title: 赤い糸でとじる
tracks.subject: a young bookbinder who hides one stitch of red thread in every notebook he sews for the girl at the neighbouring paper stall, and waits to see which page she finds it on
tracks.caption: Hungarian táncház folk-pop sung in Japanese, driving csárdás-style dance pulse. Fiddle playing a fast bowed melody with rhythmic double stops, hammered dulcimer with bright rolling mallet figures, viola kontra chopping off-beat chords, double bass on a hard two-feel, hand claps on the backbeat. Dry live village-hall room sound, gut-string and wood warmth. Young male lead, bright clear mid register, clearly sung with a small group answering on the hook. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 132 BPM, A minor. Mood: giddy, warm and bouncy. No rap, no autotune, no synths, no drum machine, no electric guitar distortion, no EDM drops.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - fiddle and dulcimer, double bass entering]

[Verse 1]
紙屋の隣の 製本屋
針と糸で 朝がはじまる
君のノートを 今日も綴じる
背表紙の角を そっと撫でて

[Pre-Chorus]
一冊に ひとつだけ
赤い糸を こっそり縫う

[Chorus]
何ページ目に 気づくかな
赤い糸 赤い糸
君が笑えば 手が止まる
何ページ目に 気づくかな

[Verse 2]
昨日は三十ページ目で
君は首を かしげてた
「この糸だけ 色がちがう」
おれは知らん顔で 紙を切る

[Chorus]
何ページ目に 気づくかな
赤い糸 赤い糸
君が気づけば 手が止まる
何ページ目で 笑うかな

[Bridge - dulcimer solo, claps]
今日の一冊は 最後のページに
糸を結んで 余らせた

[Chorus]
何ページ目に 気づくかな
赤い糸 赤い糸
ほどいてみてよ 最後まで
ここで待ってる 隣の店

[Outro - fiddle and dulcimer, ending on a stamped final chord]
赤い糸 赤い糸

tracks.title: 左足の十二時
tracks.subject: a station shoe-shine stand owner who notices that every customer's tapping foot on his footrest settles at the same tempo, and starts a Friday dance on his one chair
tracks.caption: Madchester baggy dance-rock sung in Japanese, loose shuffling breakbeat groove with a hypnotic pulse. Drums playing a live baggy beat with sixteenth hi-hats and a ghost-note snare, wah rhythm guitar scratching in short chops, rolling melodic bass guitar carrying the hook, Hammond-style organ sustaining warm chords, tambourine and maracas on every beat. Hazy 1990 indie-dance studio sound with round low end and light room echo. Young male lead, relaxed nasal mid register, clearly sung with a loose group shout on the hook. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 118 BPM, E minor. Mood: cheeky, loose and danceable. No punk, no rap, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no EDM drops, no heavy distortion.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - drum loop, wah guitar and bass groove]

[Verse 1]
駅の隅っこ 靴みがき
椅子はひとつ 台はふたつ
客の足が 台に乗ると
こつこつ こつこつ 鳴りはじめる

[Pre-Chorus]
スーツも 作業靴も
なぜか同じ 速さになる

[Chorus]
左足の十二時
ブラシも一緒に 揺れてるよ
こつこつ ゆらゆら
金曜日は 踊る日

[Verse 2]
課長の革靴 ぴかぴかにして
合図をひとつ 手をたたく
「おい 足が勝手に」
課長が笑う 駅が揺れる

[Chorus]
右足も遅れずに
クリームの缶まで 鳴ってるよ
こつこつ ゆらゆら
金曜日は 踊る日

[Bridge - organ and bass only, then drums return]
椅子はひとつ それでいい
踊る場所は ここにある

[Chorus]
みんなの足が そろったら
改札までが ステージだ
こつこつ ゆらゆら
金曜日は 踊る日

[Outro - groove loops and fades, wah guitar]
こつこつ ゆらゆら

Hazy 1990 indie-dance studio sound with round low end and light room echo. Young male lead, relaxed nasal mid register, clearly sung with a loose group shout on the hook. No punk, no rap, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no EDM drops, no heavy distortion.
metas.lyrics:
[Intro - drum loop, wah guitar and bass groove]

[Verse 1]
駅の隅っこ 靴みがき
椅子はひとつ 台はふたつ
客の足が 台に乗ると
こつこつ こつこつ 鳴りはじめる

[Pre-Chorus]
スーツも 作業靴も
なぜか同じ 速さになる

[Chorus]
左足の十二時
ブラシも一緒に 揺れてるよ
こつこつ ゆらゆら
金曜日は 踊る日

[Verse 2]
課長の革靴 ぴかぴかにして
合図をひとつ 手をたたく
「おい 足が勝手に」
課長が笑う 駅が揺れる

[Chorus]
右足も遅れずに
クリームの缶まで 鳴ってるよ
こつこつ ゆらゆら
金曜日は 踊る日

[Bridge - organ and bass only, then drums return]
椅子はひとつ それでいい
踊る場所は ここにある

[Chorus]
みんなの足が そろったら
改札までが ステージだ
こつこつ ゆらゆら
金曜日は 踊る日

[Outro - groove loops and fades, wah guitar]
こつこつ ゆらゆら

tracks.title: 目をつぶる観覧車
tracks.subject: a small-town Ferris wheel operator who has promised the hot-dog seller a free ride, and describes the whole town out loud to her all the way up because she keeps her eyes shut the entire time, afraid of heights
tracks.caption: Swedish dansband schlager sung in Japanese, steady foxtrot dance-hall pulse with a big sing-along chorus. Accordion playing the lead hook and warm chord pads, soft clean electric guitar with gentle arpeggios and a bright chorus-pedal tone, electric bass walking on the root and fifth, brushed drums with a steady snare backbeat, Hammond-style organ underneath. Polished warm 1980s dansband studio sound, dry drums, wide group backing voices. Mature male lead, warm baritone-tenor, clearly sung, with a full group of backing voices on the hook. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 108 BPM, G major. Mood: fond, bouncy and sing-along. No rap, no autotune, no synth lead, no trap hi-hats, no EDM drops, no heavy distortion.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - accordion hook over soft guitar arpeggio]

[Verse 1]
町の広場の 小さな観覧車
おれが回して 十年になる
ホットドッグ屋の 君に約束
「いつか ただで乗せるよ」

[Pre-Chorus]
今日 君は乗った
けれど目を ぎゅっと閉じてる

[Chorus]
目をつぶっても いいよ
おれが全部 話すから
ほら 見えるだろう 君の屋台
ゆっくり ゆっくり 上がっていく

[Verse 2]
右に見えるのは 駅の時計
少し遅れて 動いてる
左は川で 釣りの人たち
犬が一匹 ほえている

[Chorus]
目をつぶっても いいよ
おれが全部 話すから
ほら 見えるだろう 君の屋台
ゆっくり ゆっくり 回っていく

[Bridge - accordion alone, then band returns]
君が小さく 目を開けた
一瞬だけ 笑った

[Chorus]
目をつぶっても いいよ
でも今 ちょっと見て
ほら 見えるだろう 君の屋台
ゆっくり ゆっくり 下りていく

[Outro - accordion and guitar, gentle final chord]
もう一周 乗るかい

tracks.title: 最後のロープウェイ
tracks.subject: a cable-car operator on a mountain line who announces each station and notices that one woman rides up and down all day without ever getting off, as if she were avoiding going home
tracks.caption: Turkish arabesque pop sung in Japanese, slow 4/4 arabesk pulse with a rolling darbuka groove. Saz playing a mournful ornamented melody with quick trills, darbuka with deep dum and sharp tek patterns, string section with sweeping unison phrases and long slides, electric bass with a simple root pulse, oud doubling the chord pattern, finger cymbals on the offbeats. 1980s Istanbul arabesk studio sound, warm tape, lush string reverb, dry close darbuka. Mature male lead, rich baritone, clearly sung with ornamented vibrato on held notes. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 92 BPM, D minor. Mood: longing, slow-burning and heavy-hearted. No rap, no autotune, no electronic drums, no synth lead, no trap hi-hats, no EDM drops.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - saz melody, strings swell, darbuka enters]

[Verse 1]
山の上まで 十二分
おれはマイクで 駅を告げる
「次は 展望台前です」
彼女は降りない 今日も降りない

[Pre-Chorus]
朝からずっと 同じ席
窓の外だけ 見ている

[Chorus]
降りないのか どこへも
下の町に 待つ人は いないの
ゴンドラは 上がって 下がって
彼女の影を 運ぶだけ

[Verse 2]
昼に缶のお茶 差し入れた
「ありがとう」と 小さな声
指輪はないが 跡がある
聞かないことが おれの仕事

[Chorus]
降りないのか どこへも
下の町に 灯りは あるのに
ゴンドラは 上がって 下がって
彼女の影を 運ぶだけ

[Bridge - saz and strings alone]
今夜は少し 遅らせるよ
おれも一緒に 山を見る

[Chorus]
降りてもいいんだ いつでも
下の町は 朝になれば 変わる
ゴンドラは 上がって 下がって
最後のロープウェイ

[Outro - saz melody fading over finger cymbals]
次は 山麓です

tracks.title: パンの手紙
tracks.subject: a young bread delivery boy on a moped who finds a folded love note tucked into one baguette bag that the baker's daughter hid there, with no name and forty balconies to guess from
tracks.caption: Algerian raï pop sung in Japanese, lively 4/4 pulse with a rolling darbuka groove and call-and-response vocals. Synth keyboard playing a bright reedy lead line with quick grace notes, oud strumming a driving rhythm figure, darbuka with bouncing dum and tek patterns, electric bass locking to the kick, hand claps on every backbeat, soft synth pad underneath. 1990s Oran raï studio sound, bright and slightly compressed, dry hand drums, warm bass. Young male lead with a young female voice answering each line, clearly sung call-and-response. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 112 BPM, F# minor. Mood: playful, flirty and fast-moving. No rap, no autotune, no electronic dance drops, no trap hi-hats, no electric guitar distortion, no sampled voices.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - synth lead and oud, darbuka groove]

[Verse 1]
朝五時のパン屋で 袋を積む
原付のうしろに 四十軒ぶん
一つの袋に 白い紙
開いてみたら 手紙だった

[Pre-Chorus]
名前は 書いてない
字は 丸くて 小さい

[Chorus]
誰が書いたの 教えてよ
パンの手紙 パンの手紙
あの窓かな この窓かな
パンの手紙 パンの手紙

[Verse 2]
一階のおばさんは 首を振る
二階の兄さんは 赤くなる
三階の窓から 声が降る
「遅いよ うちは最後でいい」

[Chorus]
誰が書いたの 教えてよ
パンの手紙 パンの手紙
あの窓じゃない この窓でもない
パンの手紙 パンの手紙

[Bridge - oud and darbuka only, claps join]
粉のついた 指の跡
袋の端に 残ってた

[Chorus]
わかったよ 君だったんだ
パンの手紙 パンの手紙
明日の袋に 入れておく
パンの手紙 パンの手紙

[Outro - synth lead and claps, last hit]
明日の朝も 五時だよ

tracks.title: 검댕 묻은 손도장
tracks.subject: a chimney sweep who clears the ondol flue of one hanok every spring and gets a plate of mugwort rice cake on the step from the daughter of the house
tracks.caption: Soviet VIA-pop, 1970s vocal-instrumental ensemble style. Farfisa-style synth organ plays a bouncing riff, fuzz bass walks under a tight kit, bright clean rhythm guitar chops on the off-beats, tambourine on the chorus. Dry vintage tape warmth, slightly nasal mid-range, small studio room. Warm male tenor lead with two female backing voices answering in unison, plain earnest delivery. 124 BPM, A minor. Bouncy, bashful, sweet. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no modern EDM synths, no rapping, no heavy reverb wash.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - synth organ riff, fuzz bass and tight drums]

[Verse 1]
사다리 메고 한옥 골목으로
봄이면 제일 먼저 가는 집
솔을 밀어 넣고 한 번 돌리면
까만 눈이 우수수 내려요

[Pre-Chorus]
댓돌 위에 쑥떡 한 접시
누가 두고 갔는지 알아요

[Chorus]
까만 손으로 문 두드려요
장갑 벗고 인사할래요
쑥떡 고마워요 아가씨
굴뚝 뚫렸죠 맘은 그대로

[Verse 2]
코끝에 검댕이 묻었다고요
거울은 없고 웃음만 나요
아궁이 불꽃은 올겨울도
이 집 방바닥을 데웠겠죠

[Pre-Chorus]
댓돌 위에 쑥떡 두 접시
한 접시는 내 몫이래요

[Chorus]
까만 손으로 문 두드려요
장갑 벗고 악수할래요
쑥떡 맛있어요 아가씨
굴뚝도 맘도 이제 뚫렸죠

[Outro - organ riff and handclaps]
검댕 묻은 손도장
하얀 대문에 찍혔죠

tracks.title: 낙서 금지 토끼
tracks.subject: a wall painter who rolls NO GRAFFITI onto an alley wall every dawn and finds a chalk rabbit beside it each night, until he catches the schoolboy and paints the carrot himself
tracks.caption: Senegalese mbalax-pop. Sabar drums play fast interlocking rolls over a steady kit, tama talking drum answers the vocal phrases, bright clean rhythm guitar picks a looping ostinato, round bass bounces under. Dry tight mix, crisp hand-percussion up front. Cheerful male tenor lead with a group answering each line in call-and-response, bright open delivery. 118 BPM, D major. Playful, cheeky, danceable. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no rapping, no synth pads.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - sabar rolls, talking drum and bright guitar loop]

[Verse 1]
새벽마다 페인트 통 들고
골목 담벼락에 글씨를 써요
낙서 금지 낙서 금지
롤러가 마르기도 전에

[Pre-Chorus]
누가 분필로 토끼 한 마리
글씨 밑에 쓱 그려놨어요

[Chorus]
토끼야 토끼야 너 누구니
내가 지우면 네가 또 그려
낙서 금지 옆에 귀 쫑긋
오늘도 벽은 우리 둘이 써요

[Verse 2]
사흘을 지웠고 나흘째 숨어서
쓰레기통 뒤에서 기다렸더니
책가방 멘 꼬마가 하품하며
분필 한 자루 꺼내 들어요

[Pre-Chorus]
그 애가 날 보고 씩 웃어요
나도 모르게 붓을 내밀어요

[Chorus]
토끼야 토끼야 너 꼬맹이구나
내가 지우면 네가 또 그려
낙서 금지 옆에 귀 쫑긋
이번엔 내가 당근을 그려요

[Outro - sabar and talking drum]
낙서 금지 토끼는 허용
귀 쫑긋 쫑긋 쫑긋

tracks.caption: 1970s Persian pop. Clean electric guitar with light chorus plays a sliding minor-mode melody, tombak keeps a rolling 6/8-feel groove with finger rolls, a lush string section sweeps in long lines on the chorus, round bass guitar underneath. Vintage studio warmth, gentle plate reverb on the strings. Warm male baritone lead, tender and slightly trembling, plain intimate delivery. 98 BPM, D minor. Wistful, hesitant, tender. 찻집 구석 낡은 탁자 위에

첫 줄이 도무지 안 나와요

tracks.title: 해시계 여섯 시
tracks.subject: a man who built a plywood sundial on his rooftop with a painted line for six o'clock and secretly drew the line twenty minutes early so his girlfriend is never late
tracks.caption: Dominican bachata. Requinto lead guitar plays bright fast arpeggios with a sharp pick attack, nylon rhythm guitar strums the off-beat, bongos and güira keep the bachata groove, round bass walks under. Clean, warm, close mix. Warm male tenor lead, smooth and sincere, light bachata-style vocal turns on line ends. 128 BPM, E minor. Tender, devoted, gently teasing. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no rapping, no reggaeton dembow beat.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - requinto arpeggio, bongos and güira]

[Verse 1]
옥상에 해시계를 만들었어
합판에 못 하나 꽂아서
오후 여섯 시 그림자 닿는 곳
흰 페인트로 선을 그었지

[Pre-Chorus]
그 선에 그림자가 닿으면
계단 올라오는 네 발소리

[Chorus]
그림자가 선에 닿았어
너는 아직 계단 아래
괜찮아 그 선은
이십 분 일찍 그은 거야

[Verse 2]
네가 늦는다고 말하는 날엔
나는 해보다 먼저 서 있어
구름이 시계를 가려도
네 발소리는 정확하니까

[Pre-Chorus]
오늘도 선을 넘은 그림자
문 열리는 소리가 나

[Chorus]
그림자가 선에 닿았어
너는 이제 문 앞이야
거봐 넌 한 번도 안 늦었어
내 시계로는 말이야

[Outro - requinto and bongos]
이십 분만 더
내 해시계는 네 편이야

tracks.subject: a street-lamp repair worker on a lift truck who leaves one lamp flickering on purpose so a girl at a third-floor window keeps lowering a basket of barley tea to him each Thursday
tracks.caption: Georgian polyphonic choir-pop. Panduri plays plucked folk chords and a rolling bass figure, three-part male harmony group sings in close intervals with a low drone bass voice beneath, light frame drum on the beat, upright acoustic bass. Natural hall ambience, warm woody mix. Three male voices, a clear tenor melody over a baritone second voice and drone bass, steady open-throated delivery. 92 BPM, G major. Warm, wry, unhurried. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM synths, no rapping, no electric guitar distortion.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - panduri figure, drone bass voice enters]

[Verse 1]
목요일 아침 노란 작업차
가로등 아래 바구니 하나
삼 층 창문에서 줄이 내려와요
따뜻한 보리차 한 잔

[Pre-Chorus]
전구는 십 분이면 갈지만
차는 천천히 마셔야죠

[Chorus]
깜박깜박 이 가로등만은
고치지 않고 두고 갈래요
다음 주 목요일 또 올 테니
바구니도 또 내려와요

[Verse 2]
점검표엔 이상 없음 적고
본부엔 부품이 없다고 해요
소녀는 창가에서 손 흔들고
나는 헬멧을 들어 답해요

[Pre-Chorus]
반장님은 알면서도 모른 척
자기 몫 차도 부탁해요

[Chorus]
깜박깜박 이 가로등만은
아직도 안 고치고 있어요
다음 주 목요일 또 올 테니
바구니에 과자도 담아줘요

[Outro - panduri and three voices]
깜박 깜박 깜박
목요일의 가로등

tracks.title: Surat Di Belakang Dail
tracks.genre: Romanian lautari taraf folk dance (hora lenta to sirba)
tracks.subject: a radio repairman in Taiping opens an old Philips valve radio and finds a 1974 love letter behind the dial, then spends the evening tracing its owner by the shop stamp on the back
tracks.caption: Romanian lautari taraf village dance, slow hora into a quickening sirba. Lead violin with ornamented slides and double-stop drones, accordion chords and trills, cimbalom tremolo rolls, plucked double bass on the beat. Live acoustic room, dry close-miked, no reverb wash. Male baritone, warm mid register, sung storytelling. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 92 BPM, D minor. Wistful then warming mood. No pop beat, no electronic drums, no autotune, no synths, no rap.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - solo violin slides over cimbalom tremolo]

[Verse 1]
Pak Rahim buka belakang radio
Habuk lama jatuh atas meja
Valve dah mati, wayar pun layu
Ada sampul kuning terselit di dalam

[Pre-Chorus]
Dakwat pudar, tulisan tangan
Tahun tujuh puluh empat

[Chorus]
Surat di belakang dail, siapa punya
Cap kedai Taiping di belakang radio
Dia baca perlahan, sambil pasang lampu
Malam ini juga dia nak cari tuannya

[Verse 2]
Dia tanya kedai kopi, tanya tukang jam
Mak Cik Zainab geleng, tapi senyum
Ada nama Halimah di lorong sebelah
Rumah papan, tingkap masih terbuka

[Bridge - accordion and cimbalom alone]
Tangan dia menggigil pegang sampul
Dia ketuk pintu, jantung berdegup

[Chorus]
Surat di belakang dail, ini dia punya
Cap kedai Taiping di belakang radio
Halimah baca perlahan, sambil pegang dada
Malam ini radio itu berbunyi semula

[Outro - violin and accordion slow to a held chord]
Radio berbunyi semula

tracks.title: Burung Pesan Teh Tarik
tracks.subject: a murai bird hung at a kopitiam hook each morning copies the kettle whistle and the aunty's 'teh tarik satu', and now customers order from the bird
tracks.caption: DC go-go live groove, nonstop conga and cowbell pocket with a swung sixteenth-note shuffle. Congas and timbales up front, cowbell on every beat, funk guitar chops with wah, round electric bass, short brass stabs. Live club room, dry and punchy, crowd-style group answers. Male lead with group shouts answering each line, bright mid register. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 104 BPM, G minor. Playful, bouncy, comic mood. No trap hi-hats, no EDM drop, no autotune, no rap, no synth pads.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - congas and cowbell lock in, guitar chop]

[Verse 1]
Pagi-pagi Abang Din gantung sangkar
Kat kopitiam Ipoh, tepi tiang kipas
Burung murai tengok cerek mendidih
Dia dengar bunyi, dia pun tiru

[Pre-Chorus]
Piii, cerek berbunyi
Teh tarik satu, teh tarik satu

[Chorus]
Teh tarik satu, kata burung
Teh tarik satu, jawab budak
Kopi O kosong, kata burung
Kopi O kosong, jawab dapur

[Verse 2]
Pelanggan baru duduk, tak sempat buka mulut
Burung dah jerit, Roti bakar dua!
Mak Cik kaunter ketawa, pegang perut
Abang Din garu kepala, duit masuk laci

[Bridge - congas alone, handclaps]
Siapa nak kopi, tanya burung
Siapa bayar, tanya burung

[Chorus]
Teh tarik satu, kata burung
Teh tarik satu, semua jawab
Kopi O kosong, kata burung
Kopi O kosong, satu kedai nyanyi

[Outro - cowbell and congas fade, last brass stab]
Teh tarik satu

tracks.title: Labuh Gaun Dia
tracks.subject: a dressmaker pins the hem of his fiancée's wedding gown on his knees while she insists on wearing sneakers underneath, so he lets the hem change at every fitting
tracks.caption: Argentine cuarteto cordobes dance, tunga-tunga bounce with a driving tropical swing. Bright piano-style keyboard montuno riffs, punchy electric bass on the offbeat, congas and timbales, scraped guiro, short brass stabs. Dance-hall mix, lively and close. Male tenor lead, bright and warm, cheerful lilt. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 118 BPM, A minor. Joyful, teasing, romantic mood. No electronic drop, no autotune, no rap, no reggaeton dembow, no slow ballad.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - keyboard riff, congas and timbales join]

[Verse 1]
Aku melutut atas lantai butik
Peniti dalam mulut, pita ukur di leher
Dia berdiri atas bangku kecil
Kasut sukan putih, di bawah gaun

[Pre-Chorus]
Abang, panjang lagi sikit
Abang, pendek lagi sikit

[Chorus]
Labuh gaun dia, tiap minggu lain
Aku jahit semula, aku tak kisah
Asal dia senyum, asal dia sayang
Labuh gaun dia, aku ikut dia

[Verse 2]
Minggu ini dia nak gaun senang menari
Minggu depan dia nak gaun senang berlari
Aku tanya, kenapa tak pakai kasut tinggi
Dia kata, nanti aku tersandung

[Bridge - keyboard and percussion break]
Satu, dua, tiga, ukur lagi
Peniti jatuh, dia ketawa

[Chorus]
Labuh gaun dia, tiap minggu lain
Aku jahit semula, aku tak kisah
Asal dia senyum, asal dia sayang
Labuh gaun dia, kasut sukan pun naik pelamin

[Outro - brass stabs and congas, keyboard riff out]
Aku ikut dia

tracks.title: Empat Minit Lambat
tracks.subject: a municipal clock winder in Taiping climbs the tower every Sunday and keeps the clock four minutes slow, the time his wife takes to wave from the window
tracks.caption: Ethio-jazz in the Addis Ababa 1970s style, hypnotic minor pentatonic groove with a lilting swung pulse. Vibraphone ostinato, tenor saxophone and muted trumpet playing winding unison lines, Fender Rhodes chords, round walking electric bass, brushed drum kit. Warm analog studio room, dry brass, soft vibraphone ring. Male baritone, smoky mid register, restrained delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 86 BPM, E minor. Wistful, dignified, slow-burning mood. No synth pad, no autotune, no rap, no EDM drums, no fast tempo.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - vibraphone ostinato, bass enters, saxophone line]

[Verse 1]
Setiap Ahad Pak Karim panjat menara
Seratus tiga puluh anak tangga
Dia buka pintu besi jam besar
Dia putar kunci, dia dengar roda

[Pre-Chorus]
Orang kata jam ini lambat
Dia senyum, dia diam saja

[Chorus]
Empat minit lambat, biarlah lambat
Tingkap rumah sana belum tertutup
Dia melambai, aku tengok sampai habis
Empat minit lambat, itu masa kami

[Verse 2]
Budak sekolah marah, lewat ke kelas
Kerani bank marah, lewat ke kaunter
Dia tak jawab, dia sapu minyak
Dia pandang jalan, pandang rumah kecil

[Bridge - trumpet and vibraphone alone]
Minggu depan dia lambai lagi
Jam berdetik, dia pun mengira

[Chorus]
Empat minit lambat, biarlah lambat
Tingkap rumah sana belum tertutup
Dia melambai, aku tengok sampai habis
Empat minit lambat, jangan betulkan

[Outro - vibraphone and saxophone, bass holds the pulse]
Jangan betulkan

tracks.title: Empat Ulas Satu Durian
tracks.genre: barbershop quartet (four-part a cappella harmony, tags and swipes)
tracks.subject: four office mates split a single durian from a roadside stall and argue over who gets the biggest pod
tracks.caption: Barbershop quartet a cappella, four unaccompanied male voices in close four-part harmony with ringing chords, lead voice carrying the melody, tenor above, baritone below, bass anchoring on the roots. Swipes, tags and a held final chord. Dry intimate hall, no reverb wash, voices only. Warm mock-solemn delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 98 BPM, F major. Comic, warm mood. No instruments, no drums, no autotune, no rap, no synth pads.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - bass hums the root, three voices enter in harmony]

[Verse 1]
Empat orang kawan duduk bulat
Satu durian tengah meja plastik
Penjual hulur pisau, kami tenung
Kami buka, bau penuh gerai

[Pre-Chorus]
Satu, dua, tiga, empat ulas
Siapa dapat yang paling gemuk

[Chorus]
Empat ulas satu durian
Ambil adil, ambil adil
Yang besar itu, siapa punya
Empat ulas satu durian

[Verse 2]
Si Jamal kata, dia yang belanja
Si Wong kata, dia yang cari gerai
Si Raju kata, dia yang kupas
Aku kata, aku yang lapar

[Bridge - tenor and bass swap lines, tag]
Biji pun nak dibahagi
Siapa kalah, dia basuh tangan

[Chorus]
Empat ulas satu durian
Ambil adil, ambil adil
Yang besar itu, kami belah empat
Empat ulas satu durian

[Outro - tag, swipe up to a held chord]
Empat ulas, satu durian

tracks.title: 斷線的風吹 Tn̄g-suànn ê Hong-tshue
tracks.subject: A Tamsui kite maker whose Saturday customer keeps coming back to buy the same red-tailed butterfly kite, always 'lost' with the string cut clean as if by scissors, until she hides her phone number on the tail and he comes in empty-handed to invite her to the riverbank.
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien Zimbabwean-style mbira pop, bouncy interlocking groove. Mbira playing a looping two-bar ostinato with bright metallic buzz; hosho shakers keeping steady eighth notes; clean electric guitar interlocking with the mbira in offset patterns; electric bass walking a rolling line; drum kit with a light closed hi-hat and rim click. Dry live band mix, bright interlocking parts, plain close vocal. Female alto, bright and slightly cheeky, clearly sung melody, one lead voice. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 112 BPM, G major. Playful, teasing Saturday mood. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no synth pads, no EDM drop, no throat singing.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
我佇淡水開一間風吹店
竹仔剖幼 紙仔糊平
逐禮拜六 有一个少年
買一隻風吹 紅尾的蝶仔

[Pre-Chorus]
伊講欲去河邊放
暗頭仔 提空手轉來

[Chorus]
線斷去矣 伊講線斷去矣
斷甲遮整齊 親像剪刀剪
線斷去矣 我共伊收錢
閣做一隻 等伊禮拜六

[Verse]
我問伊 風敢真大
伊講 大 線予風拖走
我看伊的手 無半條線痕
乖乖仔 共錢數予我

[Pre-Chorus]
第五擺 我偷偷佇尾溜
寫一組電話號碼

[Chorus]
線斷去矣 這擺我知影
斷甲遮整齊 是伊家己剪
線斷去矣 我嘛袂受氣
閣做一隻 等伊禮拜六

[Verse]
這禮拜六 伊空手入來
講今仔日 毋是欲買風吹
袂放矣 免剪線矣
伊講欲請我 做伙去河邊

[Bridge]
一條線 兩个人 牽
風來風去 攏無要緊

[Chorus]
線無斷 這擺線無斷
兩个人牽 一隻紅蝶仔
線無斷 我嘛袂收錢
這隻 算我送你

[Outro]
紅尾的蝶仔 佇河邊
兩條手 牽一條線

tracks.title: 上尾一格 Siōng-bué Tsi̍t-keh
tracks.mood: tender, tongue-tied, relieved at the last second
tracks.subject: A husband who stormed out over selling the old rattan chair stands at the last card-phone booth outside Tainan station with a dead mobile and one unit left on his phone card, dials the only number he remembers, cannot speak, and hears her tell him not to hang up.
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien 1960s nightclub slow-waltz ballad in 3/4, Taiwanese kayokyoku-era feel. String section sustaining long legato lines; clarinet playing a sighing countermelody with vibrato; nylon-string guitar arpeggiating the waltz; upright bass on beat one; brushed drums on a soft three-count; piano filling gently between lines. Warm vintage 1960s studio mix, light tape sheen, plain close vocal with short room reverb. Male baritone, warm with slow vibrato, clearly sung melody, one lead voice. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 84 BPM, A minor. Tender, tongue-tied mood, relieved at the end. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no synth pads, no electric guitar distortion, no EDM drop.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
電話亭 徛佇車頭邊
我的手機 電攏無去
袋仔內 干焦一張電話卡
顯示的字 賰上尾一格

[Pre-Chorus]
我袂記得別人的號碼
干焦這一組 四十年無換

[Chorus]
喂 是我 我毋是欲吵
嘟嘟聲咧催 錢欲用完
喂 你若敢聽 就免講話
聽我的喘氣 就知我佇遮

[Verse]
透早為著一張舊藤椅
我講欲賣 你講免賣
我大聲講話 就挵門出去
連外套 都囥佇椅仔頂

[Pre-Chorus]
卡仔咧叫 賰十秒鐘
我的喙 閣是拍結

[Chorus]
喂 是我 這擺是我毋著
嘟嘟聲咧催 錢欲用完
喂 你若敢聽 就免講話
聽我的喘氣 就知我佇遮

[Verse]
電話彼頭 你先開喙
你講 我知 是你 莫掛
藤椅仔無賣矣 外套我提咧
你猶佇門口 等我

[Bridge]
嘟 一聲 卡仔吐出來
這擺 換你共我講

[Chorus]
喂 是你 免驚 我就轉去
卡仔吐出來 錢攏用完
喂 你若敢聽 免等我到
我行路轉去 十分鐘

[Outro]
上尾一格 用完矣
電話亭外口 月娘光

tracks.title: 冰角內底的批 Ping-kak Lāi-té ê Phue
tracks.subject: A woman at a Tonggang ice factory slips a sealed one-line note into each tank before the 24-hour freeze so it sits inside the block loaded on her husband's boat, and when he comes home he returns the whole bundle of salt-stained notes with a pencil reply on the last one.
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien German-style Lied art-song, through-composed feel with a repeating piano figure. Grand piano playing gentle broken-chord accompaniment with clear pedalled bass; solo cello holding a low singing line and answering the voice between phrases. Intimate chamber recording, close piano, natural room, dry vocal. Female mezzo-soprano, restrained and plain with gentle vibrato, clearly sung melody, one lead voice. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 66 BPM, E-flat major. Restrained, devoted, quietly warm mood. tracks.title: 等彼班車 Tán Hit Pan Tshia
tracks.subject: A 70-year-old hand-cranked level-crossing keeper on a Huwei sugar railway lowers the barrier at 3:15 for the one slow tourist train a day, and has waited eleven years beside the same woman on a scooter without asking her name, until the day the train is cancelled and neither of them leaves.
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien chamber folk ballad, unhurried and spare. Concert harp playing slow rolling arpeggios in open fifths; solo cello bowing long low legato lines with a warm woody tone; soft fingerpicked nylon guitar tracing a steady two-bar pattern. Intimate dry chamber-room mix, harp and cello in front, plain close vocal. Male baritone, plain and restrained, mid-low register, clearly sung melody, one lead voice. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 72 BPM, D major. Slow, patient, companionable mood. No rap, no drums, no autotune, no synth pads, no electric guitar, no EDM drop.

[Verse]
三點一刻 我共柵欄放落
手搖的鐵桿 慢慢仔斜
糖廠的細火車 一工干焦一班
行甲比行路 閣較慢

對面彼个阿姨 騎機車停佇線邊
十一冬矣 伊攏準時到

伊的菜籃仔 掛佇車頭

伊講 你搖甲比車較大聲

[Pre-Chorus]

無車 嘛愛等

等 等彼班車 等彼班車
柵欄落落去 咱兩人就無緊

鐵桿慢慢仔 起來

tracks.title: 三个零 Sann-ê Lîng
tracks.subject: A woman crouched at a Taichung station bicycle rack cannot recall her three-digit lock code, tries her birthday, her mother's and a stranger's, a crowd gathers with guesses, and a child finally tries 000, the factory setting she never changed.
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien Latin boogaloo, 1960s New York Latin-soul shuffle with a hand-clapped backbeat. Piano playing a bouncing montuno in octaves; congas and timbales locking a cha-cha-tinged shuffle; trumpet and trombone horns punching short stabs between lines; electric bass walking a tumbao; handclaps on two and four. Live 1960s club mix, punchy horns, handclaps up front, plain close vocal. Female mezzo, bright and brash with a bounce, clearly sung melody, one lead voice. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 116 BPM, F major. Cheeky, bustling mood. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no synth pads, no EDM drop, no reggaeton dembow.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
腳踏車 鎖佇車架
三碼的鎖 我袂記得
欲轉去矣 日頭落山
一个人蹲咧 旋鎖仔

[Pre-Chorus]
我先試 我的生日
無 閣試 阿母的

[Chorus]
一二三 無 三二一 嘛無
鎖仔鎖仔 你到底欲按怎
一百 兩百 三百 攏無
鎖仔鎖仔 予我轉去

[Verse]
賣報紙的阿伯 停落來
講 試看覓 你翁的生日

換一个少年 講 試看九九九

[Pre-Chorus]
一个 兩个 三个人 圍倚來
逐家 報一組 號碼

[Chorus]
一二三 無 三二一 嘛無
鎖仔鎖仔 你到底欲按怎
一百 兩百 三百 攏無

原來我 一擺都無改過
三年 逐工 攏是 零零零

鎖仔鎖仔 我三年無改
一百 兩百 三百 免試
逐家來 我請你食冰

[Outro]
零零零 零零零
明仔載 我欲改做 一一一

tracks.title: เห็ดดอกเดียวบนเนินเขา
tracks.genre: Thai highland Tibetan-style pop (dranyen and flute)
tracks.subject: Before dawn after the first rain on a hillside near Chiang Mai, forager Kaew and old Lung Boon grab the same giant mushroom at once, refuse to let go, then split it and boil it into soup on a stone fire.
tracks.caption: Thai highland Tibetan-style pop (dranyen and flute). plucked dranyen with ringing drone strings, wooden flute with breathy long notes, low hand drum on beats one and three, a few stacked female voices singing the answer lines. open mountain-air recording, natural room reverb, soft and wide. female lead, clear mid-high voice with a light vibrato, gently sung, two harmony voices answering in the chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 92 BPM, D minor. Calm, gently humorous morning warmth. No rap, no autotune, no electronic drums, no synth pads, no distorted guitar, no EDM drops.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - dranyen drone, breathy flute, soft hand drum]

tracks.title: ผีประจำตู้เจ็ด
tracks.subject: A scare actor at a Bangkok amusement-park ghost train who must leap out at car seven finds the same girl riding alone every Saturday, and today she waves at him and says hello, so he forgets his lines.
tracks.caption: Canterbury-style prog-pop (whimsical odd-meter jazz-rock). warm jazzy electric piano with extended chords, breathy flute doubling the vocal line, fuzzy melodic bass, light jazz drum kit shifting between 7/8 and 4/4, a short fuzz organ line in the bridge. warm 1970s studio tape sound, close and slightly dry. male lead, light friendly tenor in a natural speaking-sung tone, clearly sung, small backing group on the hook. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 128 BPM, A Dorian. Whimsical, playful, bumbling crush. No rap, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no EDM synths, no heavy distortion, no orchestral strings.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - electric piano riff in 7/8, flute joins, bass enters]
[Verse 1]
ผมเป็นผีประจำตู้เจ็ด
ยืนในรางไม้ เลือดปลอมเปียกแก้ม
ทุกเที่ยวผมต้องกระโดดออกมา
ตอนรถเลี้ยวสุดท้ายในความมืด
[Pre-Chorus]
แต่เสาร์นี้เธอนั่งคนเดียว
ยกมือโบกให้ผี
[Chorus]
สวัสดีค่ะผี สวัสดีค่ะผี
ผมลืมบทหมดเลย
ผีอะไรหน้าแดง ใต้เลือดปลอม
ผ้าขาวตกลงไปที่เท้า
[Verse 2]
หัวหน้าตะโกนจากหลังฉาก
ทำไมไม่กระโดด
ผมยืนนิ่งทั้งเที่ยว
เธอหัวเราะก่อนรถออกไป
[Chorus]
สวัสดีค่ะผี สวัสดีค่ะผี
ผมกระโดดตามบท
แต่หลุดปากพูดออกไป
สวัสดีครับ วันนี้เป็นไงบ้าง
[Bridge - flute and fuzz organ trade phrases in 7/8]
ตั๋วใบที่สิบแล้วนะ
เธอไม่เคยกลัวผีสักที
ผมอยากถามชื่อเธอ
แต่บทไม่มีบรรทัดนี้
[Chorus]
สวัสดีค่ะผี สวัสดีค่ะผี
คราวนี้ผมถอดหน้ากาก
ผมชื่อต้น ขอโทษที่ตกใจ
เธอบอกว่าไม่เป็นไร ชื่อใบเตย
[Outro - electric piano riff loops, flute plays the last phrase]

tracks.subject: A young hemp rope-maker in a riverside yard in Ayutthaya, walking backwards as he twists the strands, gets an order from a boat girl for a ten-wa rope to hang a hammock for two between two mango trees, and twists it slowly so she must come back.
tracks.caption: Argentine-style chacarera folk (6/8, guitar and bombo legüero). nylon-string guitar strumming a driving 6/8 chacarera pattern, bombo legüero with rim knocks on the off beats, light wooden flute, upright acoustic bass, hand claps on the chorus. dry live-room recording, earthy and close, no reverb wash. male lead, warm natural baritone in full chest voice, clearly sung, friends clapping and answering on the chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 104 BPM, E minor. Warm, teasing, quietly romantic dance feel. No rap, no autotune, no electronic drums, no synths, no accordion, no trap hi-hats, no EDM drops.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - nylon guitar chacarera strum, bombo knocks, flute]
[Verse 1]
ผมเดินถอยหลังทุกเช้า
ในลานปั่นเชือกริมน้ำ
ป่านสามเส้นพันกันเอง
เธอพายเรือเข้ามาจอด
[Pre-Chorus]
เธอสั่งเชือกเส้นหนึ่ง
ยาวสิบวาพอดี
[Chorus]
เชือกเส้นนี้ผูกเปลสองคน
ระหว่างต้นมะม่วงสองต้น
ผมปั่น ผมตี ผมบิดแน่น
ให้เปลไม่ขาดตอนเธอหัวเราะ
[Verse 2]
ผมถามเธอผูกเปลให้ใคร
เธอยิ้มแล้วพายออกไป
ผมยืนถือเชือกครึ่งเส้น

tracks.title: ชื่อเธอใต้ป้ายแหวน
tracks.genre: 1980s power ballad AOR (big drums, synth pad, guitar solo)
tracks.subject: At 2 a.m. on a scaffold above a Bangkok Skytrain line, a billboard paster glues the giant panels of a diamond-ring advert and secretly writes his girlfriend's name and a proposal in the last corner, knowing she passes it at 8:10 every morning.
tracks.caption: 1980s power ballad AOR (big drums, synth pad, guitar solo). gated big drums with huge snare, warm analog synth pad, clean chorused guitar arpeggios, fat bass guitar, a long melodic electric guitar solo with sustain, a Hammond-style organ underneath the chorus. glossy 1980s studio sound, wide gated reverb on the drums, polished and full. male lead, strong clear tenor building to a full open chest voice in the chorus, clearly sung, layered backing harmonies. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 72 BPM, E-flat major. Earnest, swelling, nervous romantic. No rap, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no EDM drops, no acoustic folk instruments, no modern vocal effects.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - synth pad swell, clean guitar arpeggio, then big drums fill]
[Verse 1]
ตีสองบนนั่งร้านเหล็ก
ผมแปะกระดาษแผ่นยักษ์
โฆษณาแหวนเพชร
หน้าคู่รักสูงเท่าตึก
[Pre-Chorus]
แผ่นสุดท้ายมุมขวาล่าง
ผมแอบเขียนตัวเล็กๆ
[Chorus]
เธอนั่งรถไฟฟ้าแปดโมงสิบ
ผ่านป้ายนี้ทุกเช้า
ถ้ามองดีๆ ใต้เงาแหวน
มีชื่อเธอ กับคำว่าแต่งกับผมนะ
[Verse 2]
ลมบนนั่งร้านแรงนัก
กาวเปียกเต็มมือ
ไฟฉายตำรวจส่องขึ้นมา
ผมบอกว่ากำลังทำงาน
[Chorus]
เธอนั่งรถไฟฟ้าแปดโมงสิบ
ผ่านป้ายนี้ทุกเช้า
ผมยืนอยู่ที่ชานชาลา
มือสั่นถือกุญแจบ้านเรา
[Bridge - long melodic guitar solo over the synth pad]
ถ้าเธอไม่เงยหน้า
กาวก็ยังไม่แห้ง
ผมปีนขึ้นไปลอกได้
แต่ผมไม่อยากลอก
[Chorus]
เธอนั่งรถไฟฟ้าแปดโมงสิบ
เงยหน้ามองป้ายนั้น
มือปิดปาก ตาแดงก่อนถึงสถานี
ผมตะโกนจากข้างล่าง ตอบผมที
[Outro - drums fall away, guitar and synth pad hold the last chord]

tracks.title: ไซริมห้วยของใคร
tracks.genre: Hill-tribe folk-pop (Karen/Akha style, bamboo flute and group chant)
tracks.subject: A young hill-village man checks his bamboo fish trap by the stream every morning and finds his fish swapped for wild bananas, then a flower, and follows small footprints in the mud to the headman's daughter by the footbridge.
tracks.caption: Hill-tribe folk-pop (Karen/Akha style, bamboo flute and group chant). bamboo flute with airy phrases, steady fingerpicked acoustic guitar, small frame drum, a bamboo tube shaker, a group of villagers chanting rhythmic answer lines in unison. outdoor-feeling live recording, natural room air, light and rustic. male lead, bright natural tenor with a rural speaking-sung tone, clearly sung, mixed group chanting the answers. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 100 BPM, G major. Light, curious, playful village warmth. No rap, no autotune, no electronic drums, no synths, no distorted guitar, no EDM drops.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - bamboo flute, fingerpicked guitar, group chant]
[Verse 1]
ผมวางไซไว้ริมห้วย
ทุกเช้ายกขึ้นมาดู
เมื่อวานมีปลาสามตัว
วันนี้มีกล้วยป่าหนึ่งหวี
[Pre-Chorus]
ใครมาแอบเปลี่ยนของ
ผมนั่งเฝ้าหลังก้อนหิน
[Chorus]
ปลาหายไป กล้วยมาแทน
ใครกันนะแอบมา
ปลาหายไป กล้วยมาแทน
ผมจะวางข้าวห่อให้บ้าง
[Verse 2]
ผมห่อข้าวต้มใบตอง
วางไว้แทนที่ปลา
เช้าต่อมาห่อหายไป
มีดอกไม้ป่าสีขาว
[Chorus]
ปลาหายไป ดอกไม้มาแทน
รอยเท้าเล็กในโคลน
ปลาหายไป ดอกไม้มาแทน
ตามไปเจอลูกสาวผู้ใหญ่
[Bridge - flute and frame drum, chant softly]
เธอยืนหน้าแดงบนสะพาน
ผมถือไซเปล่าสองมือ
ไม่มีปลา ไม่มีกล้วย
มีแต่เรายืนมองกัน
[Chorus]
ปลาไม่ต้องมี กล้วยก็ไม่ต้อง
ห้วยนี้ของเรา
ปลาไม่ต้องมี กล้วยก็ไม่ต้อง
พรุ่งนี้ผมวางไซสองใบ
[Outro - flute and chant, guitar fingerpicking ends]

tracks.title: Chữ A Nhảy Dòng
tracks.genre: tân cổ giao duyên dance-pop (cải lương-pop)
tracks.subject: A young woman brings her late grandfather's Olympia typewriter to a Sài Gòn repair stall on Lê Công Kiều; the old repairman fixes everything except the letter A that jumps a line, and she keeps coming back on Saturdays, until she realises he leaves it unfixed on purpose so she keeps visiting.
tracks.caption: Tan co giao duyen dance-pop, Vietnamese cai luong-pop sung in Vietnamese. Dan nguyet with twangy plucked phrases, dan tranh with rippling glissandi, bouncy electric bass, drum kit with light rim-click modern rhythm, bamboo sao truc flute countermelody. Clean modern pop mix, dry close room, crisp percussion. Female bright mid-range voice with clear cai luong phrasing and gentle ornament, melody clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 108 BPM, G major. Playful, teasing, warm. No rapping, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no EDM drop, no distorted guitar, no vocal effects.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - dan nguyet, dan tranh]

[Verse 1]
Máy chữ ông nội để lại
Em mang ra tiệm sửa chiều thứ Bảy
Bác thợ già nhìn qua kính lão
Gõ thử một câu, chữ A nhảy dòng

[Pre-Chorus]
Bác bảo: để bác xem lại
Tuần sau em ghé nhé

[Chorus]
Chữ A nhảy dòng, sao bác chưa sửa
Em tới hoài mà máy vẫn y như cũ
Bác cười hiền, tay lau bụi con phím
Chữ A nhảy dòng, em nhảy theo luôn

[Verse 2]
Bác sửa chiếc đồng hồ, sửa cái quạt
Chiếc máy chữ của em, bác để dành
Bác pha trà, kể chuyện thời bao cấp
Em ngồi nghe, quên cả giờ về

[Chorus]
Chữ A nhảy dòng, em hiểu ra rồi
Bác không sửa vì bác muốn em tới
Em cười lớn, gõ tên bác lên giấy
Chữ A nhảy dòng, em để vậy luôn

[Bridge - dan tranh]
Chắc ông nội cũng thích vậy
Có người ghé thăm mỗi tuần

[Chorus]
Chữ A nhảy dòng, nhảy dòng thật vui
Thứ Bảy nào em cũng mang bánh tới
Bác gõ thử một câu, em cười tủm
Chữ A nhảy dòng, mình đừng sửa nhé

[Outro - dan nguyet, sao truc]
Chữ A nhảy dòng
Thứ Bảy em tới

tracks.title: Thư Rơi Vào Hộp
tracks.subject: A girl posts a love letter into a red street mailbox on Hàng Bông and one minute later regrets it, so she waits at the box until the postman comes at four; he cannot hand letters back, but he lets her read the addresses on the pile, and she finds the boy's letter to her has been in the box just as long.
tracks.caption: Swedish indie-pop sung in Vietnamese. Bright glockenspiel lead, bouncing analog synth arpeggio, handclaps on every backbeat, round driving electric bass in eighth notes, drum kit with tambourine. Crisp shiny pop mix, tight reverb, bright top end. Female light clear soprano, bright forward delivery, melody clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 132 BPM, D major. Giddy, bright, a little panicked. No rapping, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no distorted guitar, no dark minor drones, no spoken sections.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - glockenspiel, handclaps]

[Verse 1]
Em bỏ lá thư vào hộp đỏ
Tay vừa buông là em đã hối
Hộp thư đầu phố Hàng Bông
Em đứng canh bên hộp thư

[Pre-Chorus]
Bốn giờ chú đưa thư tới
Tim em đập nhanh hơn kim đồng hồ

[Chorus]
Ơi chú đưa thư, cho em xin lại
Lá thư em viết lúc nửa đêm
Chú cười, lắc đầu: không được đâu
Thư đã vào hộp là thư đi luôn

[Verse 2]
Chú mở cửa hộp, thư đầy một túi
Em nhón chân nhìn từng cái tên
Một phong bì xanh, nét chữ quen quá
Gửi cho em, từ sáng nay luôn

[Chorus]
Ơi chú đưa thư, đừng đưa vội
Hai lá thư này cùng đi một chuyến
Em vỗ tay, chú cũng vỗ tay
Thư đã vào hộp là thư đi luôn

[Bridge - glockenspiel]
Em không nhớ em viết gì
Chắc là điều anh cũng viết

[Chorus]
Ơi chú đưa thư, em hết hối rồi
Hai lá thư gặp nhau ở đầu phố
Mai anh đọc, mai em cũng đọc
Thư đã vào hộp là thư đi luôn

[Outro - glockenspiel, handclaps]
Hộp thư đỏ ơi
Cảm ơn chú nhé

tracks.title: Vẽ Tai Anh To Hơn
tracks.genre: Khmer 1960s garage-psych rock sung in Vietnamese
tracks.subject: A street caricaturist on the pavement beside Hồ Hoàn Kiếm gets a customer who pays to have his girlfriend drawn, and she asks him to enlarge the boyfriend's ears instead; the drawing is so ridiculous the boyfriend carries it home, frames it, and finally asks her to marry him.
tracks.caption: Khmer 1960s garage-psych rock in the Sinn Sisamouth era, sung in Vietnamese. Gritty fuzz electric guitar lead with spring-reverb twang, wobbly reedy Farfisa-style combo organ riffs, thumping root-note electric bass, shuffling drum kit with tambourine, jangly rhythm guitar chops. Lo-fi 1960s mono-style recording, spring reverb, tape saturation, room bleed. Male raspy mid-range tenor, swaggering delivery, melody clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 138 BPM, E minor. Cheeky, swaggering, affectionate. No rapping, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no EDM synths, no modern polish, no screaming.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - fuzz guitar, organ]

[Verse 1]
Tôi ngồi vẽ tranh bên hồ Gươm
Ghế đẩu, giấy trắng, bút chì cùn
Anh chàng ngồi xuống, đưa tờ giấy bạc
Vẽ giùm bạn gái anh cho thật xinh

[Pre-Chorus]
Cô nhìn tôi, cô nháy mắt
Cô nói nhỏ: vẽ anh ấy đi

[Chorus]
Vẽ tai anh to hơn, to hơn nữa
Bút chì tôi chạy, cô cười nghiêng ngả
Vẽ tai anh to hơn, to như cái quạt
Anh nhìn tranh anh, anh cười cả phố

[Verse 2]
Tôi vẽ cái mũi như củ khoai lang
Tôi vẽ nụ cười rộng bằng cái chợ
Anh giật tờ tranh, mắt anh lấp lánh
Anh nói: cái này, anh mang về nhà

[Chorus]
Vẽ tai anh to hơn, to hơn nữa
Hôm sau anh tới với cái khung gỗ
Vẽ tai anh to hơn, em ơi nhìn kìa
Anh đặt tranh xuống, anh quỳ giữa phố

[Bridge - organ]
Tôi vẽ vội thêm cái nhẫn
Trên tay cô, bằng bút chì

[Chorus]
Vẽ tai anh to hơn, cô gật đầu liền
Cả phố vỗ tay, tôi vẽ không kịp
Vẽ tai anh to hơn, tôi ký tên góc giấy
Tờ tranh đầu tiên tôi tặng không lấy tiền

[Outro - fuzz guitar]
Tai anh to hơn
Bên hồ Gươm

tracks.title: Ô Chữ Số Bảy Ngang
tracks.genre: Filipino Manila sound (1970s orchestral pop) sung in Vietnamese
tracks.subject: A young newspaper delivery boy in Huế drops the paper at the same second-floor flat every morning and notices the crossword left half-filled on the table; one day he fills in seven across, and a reply in her handwriting waits the next morning, until the crossword becomes their only conversation and they finally meet at the door.
tracks.caption: Filipino Manila sound, 1970s orchestral pop, sung in Vietnamese. Lush legato string section of violins and cellos, warm French horn and trumpet swells, acoustic piano with arpeggiated chords, melodic walking electric bass, drum kit with soft ride in a gentle mid-tempo groove. Warm 1970s analog studio sound, orchestral room reverb, gentle tape warmth. Male smooth warm baritone-tenor, sincere delivery, melody clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 86 BPM, A-flat major. Tender, hopeful, sweetly wistful. No rapping, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no EDM synths, no distorted guitar, no falsetto.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - strings, piano]

[Verse 1]
Sáng nào tôi cũng đạp xe qua
Quăng tờ báo lên tầng hai nhà cô
Bàn cửa sổ còn tờ báo hôm qua
Ô chữ điền dở, bút chì còn đó

[Pre-Chorus]
Số bảy ngang còn trống
Tôi đứng đó hơi lâu

[Chorus]
Ô chữ số bảy ngang, tôi điền thử một chữ
Sáng mai tờ báo có nét chữ của cô
Nét chữ nhỏ nhắn, cô viết: đúng rồi
Ô chữ số bảy ngang, thành lời chào buổi sáng

[Verse 2]
Mỗi sáng một ô, mỗi ô một lời
Cô điền chữ Huế, tôi điền chữ thương
Chú bán báo hỏi sao tôi giao chậm
Tôi cười không nói, tay còn cầm bút

[Chorus]
Ô chữ số mười dọc, cô viết: mai gặp nhé
Tôi đứng sau cánh cửa đúng sáu giờ
Cánh cửa mở ra, bút chì trong tay cô
Ô chữ cuối cùng, hai người cùng điền

[Bridge - strings, horns]
Tôi đạp xe qua bao mùa mưa
Mới biết giọng cô dịu dàng thế

[Chorus]
Ô chữ số bảy ngang, giờ tôi đã biết
Chữ ấy là tên cô, bảy chữ cái
Cô nhìn tôi, cô khẽ cười
Ô chữ cuối cùng, hai người cùng điền

[Outro - strings, piano]
Tờ báo sáng nay
Tôi trao tận tay

tracks.title: Số Điện Đứng Yên
tracks.genre: French chanson réaliste sung in Vietnamese
tracks.subject: A meter reader on a Hải Phòng back street reads the same widow's electricity meter every month and notices that the figure has stood still for three months; she has been living by candlelight since her husband's old lamp broke, and he starts leaving new bulbs on the step with the monthly reading slip, until she turns the lamp on again.
tracks.caption: French chanson realiste, dramatic café chanson sung in Vietnamese. Piano accordion with wheezing waltz melody and bellows swells, plucked woody upright bass, soft nylon guitar arpeggios, brushed snare in a light waltz pulse, violin with long sighing countermelody. Dry intimate 1950s café-stage recording, warm tube microphone, short plate reverb. Female rich dramatic mezzo, theatrical café-singer delivery with controlled vibrato, melody clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 92 BPM, D minor. Dramatic, tender, bittersweet. No rapping, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no EDM synths, no distorted guitar, no drum machine.

[Intro - accordion, upright bass]

[Verse 1]
Anh đi qua con hẻm Hải Phòng
Mỗi tháng một lần, cuốn sổ trong tay
Nhà bà góa cuối ngõ tối om
Đồng hồ điện đứng yên ba tháng liền

[Pre-Chorus]
Anh gõ cửa, bà ra mở
Trên bàn chỉ còn ngọn nến

Số điện đứng yên, bà ơi
Con số cũ nằm đó như người xưa
Bóng đèn tắt đã lâu rồi
Số điện đứng yên, ai đếm giùm bà

[Verse 2]
Cây đèn của chồng bà vỡ hôm nào
Bà không mua cái nào khác thay
Anh để bóng đèn trước hiên nhà
Kèm tờ giấy ghi con số tháng này

[Chorus]
Số điện đứng yên, bà ơi
Anh lại để thêm một cái nữa
Anh đếm ngày, anh đếm từng ngày
Số điện đứng yên, ai đếm giùm bà

Tháng thứ tư anh đứng ngoài ngõ

No rapping, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no EDM synths, no distorted guitar, no drum machine.

tracks.title: 斜住嘅城市
tracks.subject: A Peak Tram driver who has tilted the whole of Central sideways for twenty years buys one egg tart a day from the girl at the lower-terminal kiosk and never says more, until on the steepest stretch he presses the wrong button, the announcement mic goes live, and he asks her out in front of two hundred passengers.
tracks.caption: Cantonese 1980s campus folk duo, sunny walking strum. Two steel-string acoustic guitars strumming open chords with fingerpicked answers, soft upright bass, light shaker and brushed snare, a single harmonica phrase between verses. Dry close-miked room recording, warm tape tone, no reverb wash. Male tenor lead, plain and boyish, with a gentle female harmony on the choruses, clearly sung melody on every line. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 100 BPM, G major. Bashful, warm, cheeky. No drums-and-bass pop production, no synths, no autotune, no rap, no electric guitar distortion, no big reverb.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
我揸山頂纜車 揸咗廿年
成個中環 日日斜喺窗邊
朝早七點半 山腳嗰個小檔
有個女仔 賣蛋撻 笑得好甜

[Pre-Chorus]
我日日買一個 唔敢講第二句
佢話 今日仲熱 你快啲食

[Chorus]
纜車爬上最斜嗰段
全車人 捉實扶手
我心跳得 好似個鼓
點解 就係開唔到口

[Verse]
成車遊客 舉起部電話
高樓企得斜 我心都搖晃
我背熟句子 對住個倒後鏡
點知手一震 㩒著咗個咪

[Pre-Chorus]
全車即刻靜晒 兩百對耳仔
我索性 講落去

[Chorus]
纜車爬上最斜嗰段
全車人 捉實扶手
我話蛋撻檔嗰位小姐
收工之後 同我食餐飯

[Verse]
一車人拍手 有個阿婆喊
我望住前面 唔敢回頭
落到站 佢企喺月台
手上拎住 兩個蛋撻

[Bridge]
佢話 我聽到喇
成個山頂 都聽到喇
下次你想講 行落嚟講

[Chorus]
纜車爬上最斜嗰段
全車人 捉實扶手
今朝我唔使㩒咪
佢坐喺我隔籬 食蛋撻

[Outro]
各位乘客 請捉穩扶手
前面係最甜嗰一段

tracks.title: 三米高
tracks.subject: A stilt walker working the Tsim Sha Tsui promenade at three metres tall can see every rooftop water tank in Kowloon but cannot bend down, so when a tourist toddler's coin bounces out of his hat onto the paving it takes a small girl climbing onto a bench to hand it back.
tracks.caption: Cantonese Okinawan sanshin min'yō pop, slow swaying lilt. Sanshin plucked with a bright pentatonic Ryukyu-scale riff, bamboo flute doubling the melody, soft taiko and hand-drum pulse, upright bass walking a slow lilt, finger cymbals on the off-beats. Dry close-miked acoustic room, light plate reverb, natural dynamics. Female alto, warm and clear, gently ornamented phrase endings, clearly sung melody on every line. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 88 BPM, D minor. Dignified, wry, tender. No trap drums, no autotune, no rap, no EDM synths, no distorted guitars, no bright pop chorus.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
尖沙咀海旁 我企三米高
行過人群頭頂 睇晒啲天台
冷氣機 水箱 同晾住嘅衫
冇人睇到 得我睇到

[Pre-Chorus]
但係我彎唔低 我彎唔低
兩條木腳 綁住咗我

[Chorus]
我高過成條街
但係執唔起 地下個銀仔
我高過成條街
原來低頭 都要靠人

[Verse]
頭先有個細路 擲咗個硬幣
彈出咗頂帽 滾去我腳邊
成班遊客 影相又拍掌
冇一個記得 佢仲喺度

[Pre-Chorus]
我大聲叫 喂 呢度
個細路女 先轉過頭

[Chorus]
我高過成條街
但係執唔起 地下個銀仔
佢爬上張長櫈 攞住個硬幣
踮高腳尖 遞畀我

[Verse]
收工之後 我坐喺石壆
脫低兩條木腳 好似卸低兩層樓
個女仔嘅媽咪 行埋嚟
話佢今日 第一次唔驚高

[Bridge]
行得高 唔係點睇落去
係有人肯 喺下面接住
你幫我執咗個銀仔

[Chorus]
我高過成條街
但係執唔起 地下個銀仔
我高過成條街
有人踮高 我就低頭

[Outro]
聽日我又企三米高
記得叫我 幫你睇天台

tracks.title: 三分四十秒
tracks.subject: A Sham Shui Po candle maker is asked by a young man for one taper that burns exactly three minutes forty seconds, the length of the song he will propose to, and spends the night dipping and timing twelve test candles with a stopwatch until the thirteenth is right.
tracks.caption: Cantonese enka-influenced cinematic string ballad, slow and measured. Full string section with sustained cellos and violins, solo piano playing slow broken chords, French horn answering the vocal line, tremolo violin swells and a soft timpani roll at the chorus. Wide cinematic film-score recording, warm hall reverb, intimate close piano. Male baritone, dark and steady, restrained vibrato and enka-style kobushi turns on held notes, clearly sung melody on every line. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 64 BPM, A minor. Hushed, patient, tender. No drums kit groove, no synth pads, no autotune, no rap, no electric guitar, no uptempo section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
深水埗後巷 我做蠟燭三十年
今晚有個後生 企喺鋪頭門口
佢話要一支 啱啱好燒三分四十
唔多一秒 唔少一秒

[Pre-Chorus]
我問佢 點解咁嚴
佢話 一首歌嘅長度

[Chorus]
蠟燭燒到最後一滴
要同首歌 一齊停
我浸多一次 又浸多一次
點著佢 等佢行完

[Verse]
第一支燒咗三分十秒
太短 我將燭芯換幼
第二支燒咗四分半
太長 我又換返粗

[Pre-Chorus]
十二支喺枱面 排成一行
我個秒錶 都唔夠用

[Chorus]
蠟燭燒到最後一滴
要同首歌 一齊停
我浸多一次 又浸多一次
半夜三點 點著佢

[Verse]
第十三支 燒到最後一個音
火苗跳一跳 就熄咗
我企喺度 手都震
好似自己 要去求婚

[Bridge]
我老婆企喺後面睇過
話當年 我淨係送過一枝
點到天光 都未燒完

[Chorus]
蠟燭燒到最後一滴
要同首歌 一齊停
後生仔 你嘅秒鐘
我已經 幫你點好

[Outro]
三分四十秒
慢慢燒 慢慢燒

tracks.title: 收低張紙
tracks.subject: A flyer-hander outside Mong Kok station has been refused eleven thousand times in six years and is about to give up when an old lady takes the leaflet, reads the whole thing aloud in the street, and gets a crowd to queue for the free tea at a shop that turns out to be closed.
tracks.caption: Cantonese Bulgarian-style women's choir folk-pop, driving asymmetric stomp. A women's choir singing open-throat close harmonies in tight parallel seconds, wooden kaval flute playing a quick ornamented line, tupan frame drum on a driving 7/8 pulse, a drone from a gadulka fiddle. Dry live-in-the-room village hall recording, natural room ambience, minimal reverb. Large female choir, bright chesty open-throat sound, lead voice calling and the choir answering, clearly sung melody on every line. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 108 BPM, E minor. Comic, stubborn, cheerful. No electronic drums, no autotune, no rap, no synth bass, no solo pop vocal, no slow ballad.

旺角站出口 我企咗六年

tracks.title: 多停三秒
tracks.subject: A Central observation-wheel operator who holds the wheel still for three extra seconds at the top for an old woman who rides alone every Tuesday to look at the old Star Ferry pier where she once worked as a typist, and who one Tuesday asks the operator why he never rides himself.
tracks.caption: Cantonese Cuban danzon, elegant 2/4 promenade. A wooden flute playing the lead melody, a string section of violins with elegant portamento, a grand piano with a lilting cinquillo pattern, timbales and guiro keeping a steady 2/4 danzon pulse, upright bass. Warm 1950s ballroom orchestra recording, soft room reverb, rounded vintage tone. Male tenor, smooth and courtly, light vibrato, clearly sung melody on every line. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 92 BPM, F major. Courtly, nostalgic, gentle. No trap drums, no autotune, no rap, no electric guitar, no synth pads, no fast salsa section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
中環海旁 我管住摩天輪
每個禮拜二 午後三點半
有個老婆婆 一個人排隊
手袋夾住 一張舊相

[Pre-Chorus]
圈圈慢慢轉 轉到最高
我㩒住掣 多停三秒

[Chorus]
多停三秒 多停三秒
等你睇清楚 嗰個碼頭
多停三秒 唔使人知
整個城市 靜落嚟

[Verse]
佢話 當年喺嗰度做打字員
每朝趕渡輪 裙腳飄起
而家碼頭拆咗 剩返片海
佢睇住片海 輕輕笑

[Pre-Chorus]
後面排隊嘅遊客
有人催 有人望錶

[Chorus]
多停三秒 多停三秒
等你睇清楚 嗰個碼頭
多停三秒 唔使人知
我當冇聽到 啲人催

[Verse]
有個禮拜二 佢落嚟時問我
你日日喺度 點解自己唔坐
我笑一笑 唔知點答
佢拉住我手 話 上嚟

[Bridge]
我第一次 坐上自己部機
佢喺下面 幫我㩒掣
停喺最高 三秒

[Chorus]
多停三秒 多停三秒
原來嗰個碼頭 咁近
多停三秒 唔使人知
下個禮拜二 我都喺度

[Outro]
多停三秒
慢慢轉

tracks.title: 兩個名字刻一顆
tracks.genre: Inner Mongolian long-song (urtiin duu) style ballad with tovshuur and limbe
tracks.subject: a stone name-seal carver in a lane workshop whose young couple customers cannot agree on a name for their baby, so he carves one name on each end of the same stone and tells them to press both
tracks.caption: Inner Mongolian long-song (urtiin duu) style ballad, slow free-breathing 4/4 with a Chinese lane-workshop setting. Tovshuur plucked with long ringing open-string drones, limbe flute carrying the broad slow melody with long held notes, soft frame drum on beats one and three, low string pad of cello for the floor. Wide open-air steppe-style acoustic mix with natural reverb and no drums beyond the frame drum. Male lead, warm baritone, long broad phrases, clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 72 BPM, D major. tender, spacious, dry-humoured mood. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no synth bass, no electric guitar, no dance beat, no throat-singing growls.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - limbe flute and tovshuur drone]

[Verse 1]
巷口小店 我刻了三十年章
一塊壽山石 一把刻刀
今天進來一對 年輕夫妻
她肚子大大 他手抓著頭

[Pre-Chorus]
一個說要叫 子豪
一個說要叫 子晴
兩個都不讓 都望著我

[Chorus]
刻刀慢慢走 一筆一畫
兩個名字 刻在一顆
這頭是子豪 那頭是子晴
蓋下去 紅紅的 兩個都在

[Verse 2]
我說不急 孩子還沒開口
等他哭第一聲 你們再聽
石頭放在桌上 不會吵架

[Chorus]
刻刀慢慢走 一筆一畫
兩個名字 刻在一顆
這頭是子豪 那頭是子晴
蓋下去 紅紅的 兩個都在

[Bridge - tovshuur and frame drum alone]
我自己的名字 刻過一次
那天沒人跟我吵
現在他們吵架 比我刻字還細

[Chorus]
刻刀慢慢走 一筆一畫
兩個名字 刻在一顆
這頭是子豪 那頭是子晴
等孩子出生 他自己翻面

[Outro - limbe flute alone]
章刻好了 收你一半的錢

tracks.title: 車掌今天不重複
tracks.subject: a city bus conductor with a punch pliers who calls every stop in a brand-new rhyme and never repeats one, while the regulars secretly keep a tally to bet he cannot last a whole day
tracks.caption: Greek laiko with bouzouki, hasapiko-style dance rhythm in lively 4/4 with a Chinese city-bus setting. Bouzouki playing bright tremolo and quick pentatonic runs, baglama doubling the melody an octave up, acoustic guitar strumming steady chords, upright bass walking in four, snare and darbuka-style hand drum on the hasapiko pattern. Live taverna band mix with bright room ambience and tight rhythm section. Male lead, bright strong tenor, forward and cheerful, clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 118 BPM, A minor. lively, cheeky, dance-floor mood. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no synth bass, no electric drums, no sitar, no slow rubato.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - bouzouki and baglama run]

[Verse 1]
我是這條線的 老車掌
手上一把剪票鉗
每到一站 我喊一句
今天喊的 昨天沒喊過

[Pre-Chorus]
前座的阿婆 在紙上畫線
後座的學生 偷偷在數
他們賭我 撐不到終點

[Chorus]
中山路到了 帶好你的傘
剪票鉗 喀喀響
車子搖啊搖 我的嘴不停
今天一句 都不重複

[Verse 2]
菜市場到了 籃子別忘
下一站醫院 先握緊把手
有人笑出聲 有人拍大腿

[Chorus]
公園到了 鴿子在等
剪票鉗 喀喀響
車子搖啊搖 我的嘴不停
今天一句 還是沒重複

[Bridge - bouzouki and hand drum alone]
終點站 只剩最後一句
全車安靜 連司機都回頭
我吸一口氣 清清喉嚨

[Chorus]
終點到了 大家下車
剪票鉗 喀喀響
明天請早 我的嘴休息
你們輸的錢 請我喝茶

[Outro - bouzouki tremolo and claps]
下車啦 明天見

tracks.title: 三年前的那只鐘
tracks.genre: Quebec chanson with accordion and upright bass (Mandarin storytelling)
tracks.subject: a clock repairer whose window is lined with fixed clocks nobody collected, and the woman who comes to pick hers up three years late and is told she is only three years behind
tracks.caption: Quebec chanson with accordion and upright bass, lilting 3/4 waltz-time storytelling song with a Chinese clock-shop setting. Diatonic accordion playing a lilting waltz melody and sustained chords, upright bass plucking root and fifth in three, nylon-string guitar strumming soft chords, brushed snare with a soft kick, light clarinet doubling the tune in the second verse. Intimate Montreal cafe-cabaret live mix with warm room sound and gentle plate reverb. Male lead, gentle baritone, speaking-close storyteller delivery but clearly sung on pitch. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 92 BPM, G major. wry, warm, storytelling mood. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no drum machine, no synth pads, no electric guitar solos.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - accordion and upright bass]

[Verse 1]
我的店裡 掛滿了鐘
每一只都修好 沒人來拿
牆上的指針 各走各的
窗口那一排 最準的在左邊

[Pre-Chorus]
單子上寫著 她的名字
三年了 紙都黃了
我每天 還是替她上發條

[Chorus]
滴答 滴答 它還在走
你的鐘 我天天擦
你問我現在幾點
我說 小姐 你只晚了三年

[Verse 2]
下午三點 她推開了門
說師傅 我是來拿鐘的
我說 我知道 它等你很久

[Chorus]
滴答 滴答 它還在走
你的鐘 我天天擦
你問我現在幾點
我說 小姐 你只晚了三年

[Bridge - accordion and bass alone]
她付了錢 又問我
這條街 你怎麼守得住
我說 鐘一停 我就睡不著

[Chorus]
滴答 滴答 它還在走
你的鐘 我天天擦
你問我現在幾點
我說 小姐 你剛好趕上

[Outro - accordion and nylon guitar fade]
下次別再 讓它等了

tracks.title: 白手套的路口
tracks.genre: Levantine dabke folk-pop with mijwiz, oud and tabla
tracks.subject: a traffic officer in white gloves at a busy crossroads whose hand signals start to follow a stomping beat, until pedestrians, delivery riders and a bus driver fall into step and the whole crossing moves in a line
tracks.caption: Levantine dabke folk-pop with mijwiz, oud and tabla, fast stomping 4/4 line-dance rhythm with a Chinese city-crossroads setting. Mijwiz double-reed pipe playing fast ornamented lines with a droning sustain, oud strumming a driving rhythmic figure, tabla and riq on a fast dabke pattern with strong downbeats, handclaps stacked on the offbeat, upright bass doubling the oud root. Live village-wedding-band energy mix, dry and punchy with room claps and tight percussion. Male lead, strong bright tenor, call-and-response delivery with a group answering, clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 122 BPM, D minor. upbeat, communal, stomping mood. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no electric guitar, no synth bass, no EDM drop, no slow ballad passages.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - mijwiz, tabla and claps]

[Verse 1]
早上八點 路口大塞車
我戴上白手套 站中間
左手一指 右手一擺
腳底下 忽然有了拍子

[Pre-Chorus]
一二 一二三
紅燈停 綠燈走
大家排成一條線

[Chorus]
踏 踏 踏 踏著走
手搭肩 過馬路
白手套 往左轉
整個路口 跟著我

[Verse 2]
送餐的小哥 腳尖點地
賣菜的阿姨 菜籃也搖
公車司機 按喇叭應和

[Chorus]
踏 踏 踏 踏著走
手搭肩 過馬路
白手套 往右轉
整個路口 一起來

[Bridge - oud and tabla alone]
隊長路過 看見這一幕
問我 這算什麼指揮
我說 隊長 車都沒有堵

[Chorus]
踏 踏 踏 踏著走
手搭肩 過馬路
白手套 往前指
明天路口 還是這樣

[Outro - mijwiz and claps]
綠燈亮了 各位請過
